physicalNotes: Radius 0.793 +/- 0.036 solar radii from Deeg et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract): 551,690 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.798 +/- 0.035 solar masses from Deeg et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4884 +/- 70 K from Deeg et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..12D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
